results.lower_potential_restrictions: The complete raw third and fourth potentials, with original t/rho derivatives distinguished from radial derivatives, determine explicit c,n,f primitives with arbitrary epsilon and n0 retained. Thus G has degree at most two over C in h and c0=delta-F_hh/3+G_h^2/(4C)+gamma with gamma complex. Combining the separate M=0 exclusion gives epsilon=delta_h in the actual surviving branch.
